name: Indiana
dueDateNotes: Indiana follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Indiana taxes your federal AGI at a flat 2.95% (2026) after a $1,000 personal exemption per person. Most Indiana counties add their own local income tax, which this estimate does not include.
uniqueFacts: Indiana's flat state income tax rate fell to 2.95% for 2026, with a further cut to 2.90% scheduled for 2027.
Almost every Indiana county adds its own local income tax on top of the state rate, so your true rate is higher than 2.95%.
Indiana requires estimated payments once you expect to owe $1,000 or more in combined state and county tax.
